story.title: Morocco Holds Parliamentary Elections Amid Youth Discontent and Economic Concerns
story.summary: Moroccans are voting in parliamentary elections today, with significant concerns regarding the cost of living, jobs, and inequality. Many voters, particularly the youth, express deep distrust in political parties, reflecting a broader discontent that has been evident since youth-led demonstrations a year ago. The elections are seen as a crucial test of citizens' faith in the political process as the country prepares for the 2030 World Cup.

related_stories.title: Missouri's Congressional Map Dispute Returns to Supreme Court for Third Time
related_stories.summary: The U.S. Supreme Court is set to hear a case regarding Missouri's congressional map for the third time. A federal appeals court previously sided with Republicans who aim to utilize district boundaries redrawn last year, which are believed to provide an advantage to the GOP in the upcoming midterm elections.

related_stories.title: Board of Peace Unveils Reconstruction Plan for Gaza
related_stories.summary: The US-backed Board of Peace has proposed a reconstruction plan for Gaza, outlining a six-month initiative with a budget of approximately €2.15 billion (or $2.45 billion). The plan includes 66 projects aimed at initiating reconstruction and governance in the region, amidst ongoing challenges related to the ceasefire efforts led by President Donald Trump.

related_stories.title: White House Defends Media Ban in Court, Citing National Security and Professionalism
related_stories.summary: The U.S. Justice Department has filed a response to a lawsuit from CNN, MS NOW, and Politico, which challenges the Trump administration's ban on these media outlets from White House grounds. The DOJ argues that access to the White House is a privilege, not a right, and cites national security concerns as well as accusations of unprofessional behavior by the banned outlets. The case is set to be heard in court, where the news organizations will argue that the ban violates their First Amendment rights.
